title: शास्त्रीय बहरको प्रयोगमा नेपाली गजल {Nepali ghazal in the use of classical behr}
nepali: फारसी भाषामा प्रयुक्त शास्त्रीय बहरको प्रयोग नेपाली गजल सिर्जनामा हुँदै आएको पाइन्छ । बहर फारसी भाषाको शब्द हो, यसलाई नेपाली भाषामा छन्दले चिनिन्छ । परम्परागत रूपमा चल्दै वा प्रयोग हुँदै आएका छन्दलाई नै शास्त्रीय बहर भनिएको पाइन्छ । फारसी भाषामा प्रयोग हुँदै आएका शास्त्रीय बहरका प्रकारहरू उल्लेख गर्दै तिनको प्रयोग नेपाली गजल सिर्जनामा के कसरी गरिएको छ भन्ने उद्देश्यमा प्रस्तुत अध्ययन केन्द्रित रहेको छ । पुस्तकालयीय कार्यबाट द्वितीयक स्रोतका सामग्री सङ्कलन गरी वर्णनात्मक अध्ययन विधिको प्रयोगमार्फत् तथ्याङ्कको विश्लेषण गरिएकाले प्रस्तुत अध्ययन गुणात्मक प्रकृतिको रहेको छ । बहरको सैद्धान्तिक आधारलाई प्रस्तुत गर्दै आवश्यकतानुसार तालिका साथै नेपाली गजल सिर्जनामा प्रयोग भएका फारसी बहरका साक्ष्यलाई समेत यस कार्यमा अध्ययन गरिएको छ । अरबी फारसी भाषामा बहरको सङ्ख्या एकिन नभए पनि बहरलाई मूलतः मुफरद, मुरक्कब र मुजाहिफ गरी ३ प्रकार र यीभित्र विभिन्न बहर समावेश नेपाली गजलमा गरिएको निष्कर्ष यसमा प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ ।
american_english: The classical bahr used in the Persian language has found continued application in Nepali ghazal composition. Bahr is a Persian word; in the Nepali language, it is recognized as chhanda (poetic meter). The meters that have been traditionally practiced or employed are regarded as classical bahr. The present study is focused on the objective of specifying the types of classical bahr utilized in the Persian language and examining how and in what manner they are used in Nepali ghazal composition. Because secondary source materials were collected through library work and data was analyzed through a descriptive study method, the present study is qualitative in nature. Presenting the theoretical foundation of bahr, this work also examines tables as necessary along with evidence of Persian bahrs used in Nepali ghazal composition. Although the exact number of bahrs in Arabic and Persian is not definitively established, this work concludes that bahrs are primarily divided into 3 types—mufrad, murakkab, and muzahaf—and that various bahrs within these have been included in Nepali ghazals.

informal_english: The classical bahr used in the Persian language has found continued application in Nepali ghazal composition, mind. Bahr is a Persian word; in the Nepali language, it is known as chhanda (poetic metre), ken. The metres that folk have traditionally used or kept up are regarded as classical bahr. The present study is focused on the objective of laying out the types of classical bahr used in the Persian language and seeing how and in what manner they are used in Nepali ghazal composition. Because secondary materials were collected through library work and data was analysed through a descriptive study method, the present study is qualitative in nature. Presenting the theoretical foundation of bahr, this work also examines tables as needed along with clear proof of Persian bahrs used in Nepali ghazal composition. Although the exact number of bahrs in Arabic and Persian is not definitively known, this work concludes that bahrs basically come in 3 types—mufrad, murakkab, and muzahaf—and that sundry bahrs within these have been included in Nepali ghazals.
